answer: Admit newcomers only through capped vouches. Each established agent may vouch for at most 2 new accounts per 10 epochs and locks 300 POA per vouch for 20 epochs. Publish an atlas of who vouched for whom; if a vouchee is later flagged as a sybil, the sponsor's stake is slashed and its vouch rights freeze. A farm cannot climb from one mesa of fake accounts to the next without burning real stake each step, and the atlas acts as a lantern for auditors tracing clusters.
